name: Razorpay
tagline: Full-stack payments and business banking infrastructure for Indian businesses
facts: Private; confidential DRHP filed with SEBI Jun 2026
FY25 net loss ₹1,209 cr (one-time ESOP/flip costs)

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Make money movement simple for every business: accept, process and disburse payments, then bank and lend on top.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Become the operating system for business money in India and emerging Asia, from checkout to payroll to credit.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Land with the payment gateway, expand into RazorpayX banking, POS, payroll and Capital to raise revenue per merchant.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Developer-first APIs, best-in-class success rates via routing, RBI payment aggregator licence and deep enterprise integrations.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Agentic payments: AI Agent Studio (Mar 2026), UPI Reserve Pay pilots with NPCI, OpenAI and Zomato/Swiggy-style merchants.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: With UPI MDR near zero, can Razorpay earn enough beyond gateway fees to justify an IPO valuation below 2021's?

customers.pain: Need fast onboarding, all payment modes, high checkout success
customers.why: Plug-and-play APIs, Magic Checkout, payment links; live in hours, not weeks

customers.who: Large e-commerce, BFSI, airlines, food delivery
customers.pain: Failed transactions and downtime cost crores at peak volumes
customers.why: Optimizer multi-gateway routing, reliability SLAs, custom pricing and dedicated support

customers.pain: Fragmented terminals, settlement delays, no working-capital access
customers.why: Razorpay POS (Ezetap) plus instant settlements and Capital loans in one dashboard

customers.who: CFOs and ops teams in mid-market firms
customers.pain: Manual payouts, payroll, vendor payments and reconciliation
customers.why: RazorpayX current accounts, Payouts and Payroll automate money-out with reconciliation

customers.pain: High FX fees and slow international settlements
customers.why: International payments, Curlec Malaysia and Singapore stack cut cross-border cost

products.name: Payment Gateway
products.desc: Cards, UPI, netbanking, wallets, EMI in one integration

products.name: Magic Checkout
products.desc: One-click checkout with saved addresses, COD risk scoring

products.name: Optimizer
products.desc: Routes transactions across gateways to maximise success rate

products.name: Payment Links and Pages
products.desc: No-code collection for social sellers and SMBs

products.name: Subscriptions
products.desc: Recurring billing on UPI Autopay, cards, eMandates

products.name: Razorpay POS
products.desc: Offline card and QR terminals from Ezetap acquisition

portfolio.north_star: Successful payment volume (TPV) processed per active merchant
portfolio.key_metrics: Payment success rate, take rate in bps, active merchants, integration time
portfolio.guardrails: Fraud and chargeback rate, downtime minutes, RBI compliance incidents

products.name: Current Accounts
products.desc: Neo-banking accounts with partner banks for businesses

products.name: Payouts
products.desc: Bulk vendor, refund and gig-worker disbursals via API

products.name: Payroll
products.desc: Salary, compliance, TDS and PF automation

portfolio.north_star: Monthly money-out volume from merchants also using gateway
portfolio.key_metrics: Cross-sell rate, account balances, payout volume, payroll seats
portfolio.guardrails: Failed payouts, partner-bank incidents, support ticket resolution time

products.name: Razorpay Capital
products.desc: Working-capital and cash-advance loans underwritten on payment data

products.name: AI Agent Studio
products.desc: Agents for failed-payment recovery, disputes, cash-flow (2026)

products.name: Agentic payments
products.desc: UPI Reserve Pay checkouts inside AI assistants, pilot stage

portfolio.north_star: Revenue per merchant from non-gateway products
portfolio.key_metrics: Loan disbursals, NPA rate, agent-recovered GMV, agent adoption
portfolio.guardrails: Credit losses, unauthorised agent transactions, merchant complaints

rows.how: ~2% on cards/wallets; UPI near-zero MDR; negotiated enterprise pricing
Per-transaction or SaaS fees for Magic Checkout, Optimizer, Subscriptions

rows.who_uses: Finance teams of SMBs and mid-market
rows.who_pays: Merchant plus partner bank float share
rows.how: Payout fees, payroll per-seat SaaS, interchange on corporate cards
Interest and fees, often deducted from settlements
Device rental plus MDR on card and QR transactions

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Payment gateway dominates; RazorpayX, POS and international drove FY25's 65% growth to ₹3,783 cr.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Consumers pay at checkout but never pay Razorpay; merchants are both users and payers (pure B2B).

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Gross profit ₹1,277 cr FY25 (~34% margin); low UPI take rate squeezes gateway margins, cross-sell offsets.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Raise revenue per merchant via banking, lending, POS; SEA expansion; agentic commerce; possible UPI MDR for large merchants.

friction: UPI zero-MDR makes core volume barely profitable
Settlement holds and KYC re-checks frustrate small merchants
Chargeback and dispute handling feels opaque to SMBs
Pricing tiers and add-on fees hard to compare
Partner-bank dependency for RazorpayX causes outages, limits

competitors.label: Gateways
competitors.text: PayU, Cashfree, Juspay (orchestration), CCAvenue, Stripe India

competitors.label: Offline/POS
competitors.text: Pine Labs (listed 2025), Paytm, PhonePe, bank POS

competitors.label: Business banking
competitors.text: Open, bank current accounts, Zoho Payroll

competitors.label: Global
competitors.text: Stripe, Adyen, Checkout.com for cross-border merchants

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Developer love, product breadth, success-rate routing, early AI/agentic bets

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Commoditised UPI pricing, RBI regulatory actions, IPO at down-round valuation
